# ndle

> ndle is a free URL shortener that checks the page behind every short link every 30 minutes and flags the links that break: 404s, timeouts, failed connections and expired or invalid SSL certificates.

- Free plan: 100 active links, 1 custom domain, unlimited QR codes, click analytics (country, device, referrer, UTM campaign), collections and a UTM builder.
- No ad or preview page before a link opens. Links on a free account don't expire unless the owner sets an expiry date.
- Guest links can be made without an account; they last 7 days and aren't checked.
- Short links use the ndle.fyi domain or the owner's own domain.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ndle.app/): shorten a link and see what ndle does

- [Link in bio](https://ndle.app/use-cases/link-in-bio): short, counted, checked links for Instagram and other bios
- [QR codes](https://ndle.app/use-cases/qr-codes): free, unlimited QR codes with no trial or ad page, checked every 30 minutes
